name: Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust (PLife REIT) is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust that invests in healthcare and healthcare-related assets, including hospitals, nursing homes, and senior living facilities, across Asia. The REIT generates income primarily through long-term leases with healthcare operators, aiming to provide stable and growing distributions to its unitholders. PLife REIT focuses on acquiring and managing high-quality healthcare assets in established markets like Singapore and Japan to ensure sustainable returns.
